warnings: Keep pricing, account, Amex, currency and timing statements within the captured Braintree Wells IC+ scope; do not transfer them to flat-rate or blended pricing, Marketplace, or other processor/account arrangements.
Treat the bank-appearance timing and Total Disbursed matching language as Braintree's documented reconciliation expectation, not independent bank policy or proof of an individual funded deposit.
